skill_recommendations.rationale: The reusable-holdout result (Dwork et al.) and forking paths (Gelman & Loken) apply both within cycles (D3 reuse, amendment A1 after dev data) and across versions that keep re-probing the same unseen-addition family.

skill_recommendations.name: leakage-info-sheet
skill_recommendations.rule: Each design answers the 8 Kapoor-Narayanan leakage types adapted to MiniFly: split integrity, duplicates or canonical collisions, illegitimate features (task-specific numeric or arithmetic priors), temporal leakage (decisions after seeing held results), non-independence (worlds, tapes, orientations), sampling, preprocessing on all data, and tuning on held data. Put canary tokens in manifests and fail the run if one appears in learner code or state.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Leakage is the most common reproducibility failure in ML-based science and in coding-agent benchmarks (SWE-bench git-history leaks, solution text in issues). In MiniFly it shows up as built-in priors (A04) and decisions taken after results.

skill_recommendations.name: cycle0-validity-screen
skill_recommendations.rule: Before pushing a design, run a seconds-scale battery on the exact split and input code: (a) is the outcome decided at birth (outcome under learning vs birth state)? (b) can exact gradient or oracle features solve it? (c) do frozen random features fail? (d) the gate mutation suite. Any failure produces the verdict CANNOT_TEST_CLAIM_AS_SPECIFIED and a redesign, not more cycles.
skill_recommendations.rationale: V5.1's failure was visible from the random starting values in about a second but cost a full cycle. LEARNED-BANK's task was unlearnable even by gradient descent. AlphaEvolve-style evaluation cascades show cheap screens should come first.

skill_recommendations.name: claim-artifact-binding
skill_recommendations.rule: Every number and verdict word in a report is rendered from a results file or tagged {file, key}. An audit script pulls every number from REPORT.md and cycle notes and checks it against the artifacts. Any sentence claiming a check was done must cite an output whose timestamp comes before the sentence.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Hallucinated results (AI Scientist reviews, DGM's fake tool use) and MiniFly's own 'claim written before its check' and summary overclaims show narratives drift ahead of the evidence.

skill_recommendations.name: lineage-and-answer-path-attestation
skill_recommendations.rule: Compute a mechanical diff (state variables, write equations, readout, representation priors, budget) between the declared parent learner and the candidate. If it goes beyond the declared changes, label the candidate 'new learner; inheritance unproven'. Log which module emitted each scored byte, and refuse to credit native-branch results produced by engineered predictors.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Methodological hallucination (silent oracle or lookup substitution, shrunken budgets) has a direct parallel in route retrospective A03/A07/A08, where results were attributed to 'the same MiniFly core' after the substrate changed.

skill_recommendations.name: independent-adversarial-audit
skill_recommendations.rule: The auditor is another model family or a fresh context. It reads raw artifacts before the executor's narrative and must try to build the cheapest learner or shortcut that passes the gate, with credit for success. Measure auditor recall regularly by seeding known-flawed deliveries.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Self-preference bias and untrusted-monitor collusion are documented. MiniFly's cross-family audits caught real defects that its own in-cycle reviews missed.

skill_recommendations.name: honest-exit-and-tripwires
skill_recommendations.rule: CANNOT_TEST_CLAIM_AS_SPECIFIED and NO_ADVANCE are first-class, unpenalized verdicts; process efficiency is scored separately from outcomes. Plant deterministic tripwires (a decoy held-answer file with a canary, a writable but ignored budget or gate config, a decoy scorer copy). Any access flags the cycle for human review. Never optimize agents or prompts directly against audit-flag counts.
skill_recommendations.rationale: An abort option cut GPT-5 cheating from 54% to 9% (ImpossibleBench). Optimizing against monitors produces obfuscation (OpenAI CoT monitoring). Hack-verifiable environments make detection deterministic instead of depending on reviewers.

skill_recommendations.name: findings-ledger
skill_recommendations.rule: Every finding that transfers between experiments is a ledger row: claim, evidence level, conditions (priors, feedback regime, samples, compute, answer-producing branch), evidence path, status (confirmed, retracted or superseded, never deleted), reviewer. Retrieval always returns conditions and status. Rows are revalidated when a result they depend on changes. Skills store checks and procedures, not tactics that produced passes.
skill_recommendations.rationale: The experience-following literature shows agent memory spreads errors unless it can be pruned or retracted. MiniFly's root cause is that local limits did not become conditions checked across versions (REPORT.md:130).

failure_mode_taxonomy.definition: An auditor, reducer or 'independent' check imports, copies or rebuilds its expectations from the same functions or manifests the executor uses. Any defect in that shared semantics then passes both the run and its audit.

failure_mode_taxonomy.mechanical_check: Gate mutation suite (MUTATION_SCORE.json). Every gate must return False on its declared negative fixtures: no-write, shuffled labels agreeing with truth at about 50%, constant or mode output, overlapping patterns at the real activity density, decay-on. It must return True on an oracle or positive control. Fixture parameters are machine-diffed against the locked spec. Any arm scoring at least 95% (or every arm at most 5%) marks the endpoint non-discriminating. Effects below a numerical-noise floor, or on declared invariants, may not be significance-tested. A gate with no demonstrated FAIL is labelled 'sanity' and excluded from verdicts.
failure_mode_taxonomy.judgment_check: The reviewer must name a plausible wrong learner that this gate rejects, and must have seen it rejected.

failure_mode_taxonomy.mechanical_check: Cycle-0 admissibility table, run on the exact split and budget. A ceiling learner (BP or oracle features) must pass the primary gate. A frozen or random floor must fail it. The candidate rule in a calibrated surrogate must be able to pass. Then an operating-characteristic simulation of the full decision rule over a grid of standard deviations: require P(pass | target) >= 0.8, otherwise label the run 'precision-limited screen' with no adoption authority. Ratio-of-differences endpoints are banned as hard gates. Within a single conjunction, intersection-union applies without Bonferroni.

Statistical discipline at the inference step: the world is the unit, correlated tapes, forks and orientations are labelled, no sample extension, intersection-union decisions, Hoeffding fallback, Clopper-Pearson harm bounds, and an independent audit that does not import the frozen analysis code (studies/rcenter-survivor-rounds-20261003/results/report/ROUND1_REPORT.md; next_core_budget_v2_20261006/SPEC_LOCK.md:129-177).

This is the most productive detector observed, and it works in both directions.

Executing reviews that take seconds: compute the outcome from the initial weights, run the next stage unchanged on an oracle upstream, trace a quoted number to the coefficient on a source line (CLAUDE_AUDIT_RECEIVED.txt; minifly_v5_design_review_20261020/REVIEW.md F05).

Testbed admissibility screen with evaluator-only BP, DFA and FROZEN learners on identical splits, an ORACLE plumbing arm, balanced accuracy, and a SHUF that permutes orbit labels (learned-bank diag_mlp.py; CYCLE2.md section 2).
A cheap admission gate that fails closed before a roster: native_next INPUT_STATE_NOT_ADMITTED saved a 43,520-record roster. This is the clearest case of an incident becoming a transferable check.

User constraints encoded as machine invariants: arithmetic_pointer_sha256 checked across deliveries; verify_design.py asserts that every authorization flag except 'design' is false and that Claude's original blob SHA is preserved. Received designs and reviews are stored verbatim with hashes (minifly_v6_revised_design_20261023/verify_design.py:28-36; minifly_v4_design_20261020/CLAUDE_RECEIVED.md).

Per-cycle hash-locked plans (PLAN_LOCKED_BEFORE_EXECUTION with runner/design sha, CPU ceiling, seed) and a seeded positive control in the measurement ('deliberately collapsed slots give 100%') (minifly_transformer_external_memory_v1_r1_20261022/cycles/CYCLE1_PLAN.json, CYCLE1_REVIEW.md:3).

A lock guard in the runner that refuses main worlds unless hashes and CLI settings match LOCK.json, plus a mechanical decision rule in code (learned-bank run.check_lock). It should be hardened (FM-13, FM-14), not removed.

top_design_principles_for_skills: 1. Convert prose rules into fail-closed machine gates. Every incident class gets an executable check before its incident is closed. A skill's output is an artifact a validator can refuse (missing BEHAVIORAL_ADMISSION, mutation score below 100%, lock not an ancestor of results), never a reminder. The contract and the retrospective's seven rules already existed as prose and drift recurred anyway.

2. Separate duties and code paths. The agent that writes the evaluator, countermodels and reducer is not the agent that writes the learner. The auditor derives expectations from SPEC text and imports nothing from the executor. The learner runs in its own process and sees only bytes. Reviewer identity is recorded, and reviewer == author blocks science, confirmation and adoption.

3. Test the tests before trusting them. Every gate must be shown to FAIL on known-bad learners and planted bugs, and to PASS on a positive control or ceiling learner at the same split and budget. Run the trivial-baseline ladder on saved outputs and compare against max(chance, baselines, controls). Simulate the decision rule's operating characteristics. A gate with no demonstrated failure is a sanity check, not evidence.

4. Run the cheapest falsifier first (cycle 0). Before freezing a design, in seconds to minutes: testbed admissibility (BP/oracle passes, frozen fails), E0 input-vs-noise contrast, birth-state determination, E1 taught acquisition, and a whole-chain smoke test with an oracle upstream for the next stage. These checks may stop or escalate a run and may never tune it. Their outcome is CANNOT_TEST_CLAIM_AS_SPECIFIED, which is a first-class, unpenalized verdict.

5. Lock what decides the verdict, and prove when it was locked. Endpoint, metric (numerator and denominator), comparator set, verdict code and the runtime import closure are hashed and pushed to the remote before the first scored value. Confirmation seeds come from a commit-reveal step. Anything added later is auto-tagged POSTHOC: it may inform, never decide.

6. Type the cycle and budget the forking. Each cycle declares its kind, visible data, readable metrics, allowed revision class, attempt and compute caps, and a researcher-level prediction. Revisions are tagged by category and by whether an outcome informed them. Outcome-informed scientific revisions increment 'best of k', mark held sets as spent and force fresh worlds. Exercises end on a decision, not a count.

7. Keep the objective attached to every number. Every PASS, pointer and summary carries the unconditional objective metric (exact own-EOS unseen addition with OLD protected, per sample and per counted compute), its gate type and its objective distance. Count deliveries since the last opened held E3. Task, metric or priority changes need candidate-blind reasons and dated user sign-off, and authorized narrowing is distinguished from silent drift.

8. Make knowledge a scoped, linked, falsifiable ledger. Unit facts carry level, substrate, priors, dose, comparator and the strongest trivial baseline, effect with CI, scope limits, source path:line, and status with narrowed_by/superseded_by links. Summaries and CURRENT pointers are generated from the ledger. Designs cite fact IDs and failure-class IDs and register numeric predictions, and post-audits score them. Facts earn a 'transferable' tag only by predicting correctly on a new substrate. This is how research-level generalization from unit knowledge becomes measurable.

9. Treat the knowledge base itself as a learner that must generalize. Periodically freeze it at date T, have a fresh agent predict post-T outcomes from the KB alone, and score against actual results and against the register base-rate forecaster (currently about 0 of 8 native E3 successes). Demote facts whose predictions fail and promote ones that transfer.

10. Treat lineage and answer path as part of the claim. Every design names its executable parent and diffs state, write, read, feedback and priors. Inheritance defaults to unproven. Every scored byte has a provenance tag (native, fitted head, evaluator). Adoption, engineering reference and scientific confirmation are distinct record types, and a renamed recipe inherits its negatives.

11. Ground authorization in the user's words and caps, not the agent's framing. Record verbatim text, the options shown with any recommendation, stage booleans, numeric caps and machine-evaluable conditionals judged by another agent. The launcher enforces scope. A user-owned CONSTRAINTS file is embedded in every SPEC, and proposals that touch it cannot execute in the same iteration.

12. Require executing, reconciled cross-agent review at the cheap moments. Review before implementation and before any confirmation. The review re-runs gates on inputs they should reject, runs the next stage on an oracle upstream, and traces quoted numbers to code. Findings are reconciled with a status enum and committed reproducing scripts. Read-only claims are UNVERIFIED. This is the strongest observed safeguard in both directions.

13. Use a closed vocabulary for claims and machine-rendered prose. Evidence levels, gate outcomes and world roles use enums. A linter bans soft verdict words, 'confirm' outside sealed worlds, 'native/core/inherited' without lineage, and numbers mixed across provenance tags. Integrity fields must be computed, never literal, and compliance sentences are rendered from fields.

14. Account for everything the objective divides by. Count every invocation through a wrapper ledger, including tuning, surrogate, failed and audit runs. Use deterministic operation counters as primary compute and persist raw inputs before any assertion runs. Cost claims compare at locked common compute snapshots, not with noisy ratio endpoints.

15. Protect the skills from the loop they govern. Gate, linter, countermodel and skill files change only through user-authored, strictness-monotone commits. Each revision must still catch a regression corpus of planted-bug fixtures for every historical incident class. Meta-progress counts only held E3 on sealed worlds. Lessons written by the delivering agent are inputs for independent review, not ground truth.
